extraction.notes: Three months ended June 30, 2023 column only. Starting line and FFO/Core FFO taken from the detailed FFO & Core FFO table (page seq 14, printed 11); the Statements of FFO and Core FFO table (seq 36) has the same figures. Both subtotals tie: -27,434 + FFO adjustments = -289; -289 + Core adjustments = 15,764; 15,764 + AFFO adjustments = 18,810 (Core AFFO). Reported FFO per share $0.00 reproduces as -289/100,854 (~ -$0.003). Core FFO per share $0.16 reproduces as 15,764/100,854. Company does not report AFFO per share, so affo is null. Zero-amount lines (Land and other impairments, Gain on disposition of developable land, Lease breakage fee, Amortization of lease inducements) are included as printed with amount 0. The 'Interest derivative' / 'Amortization of derivative premium' line is printed as positive 1,619 in the FFO table. Recurring capex is deducted within the AFFO section, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Page 15 printed page marker is blank in the source; the printed number '12' appears only in body text, so page_printed left ''. Diluted shares in thousands (100,854) matches page 8 figure 100,854,172.
